title: Revenue Accounting Annexe for Air Ticket Fare Brands: The Agency Service Fee Retained on a Booking
content:
The agency service fee retained on a booking under the Air Ticket Fare Brands terms is determined from the agency service fee lines standing on that booking and the number of travellers the booking record carries.

Where an agency service fee line stands for each traveller on the booking, the agency service fee retained is the total of the service fee lines standing on the booking.

Where at least one agency service fee line stands on the booking but fewer of them than there are travellers, the agency service fee retained is the agency service fee of the fare brand held taken once for each traveller on the booking.

Otherwise the agency service fee retained is the agency service fee of the fare brand held, taken once.

| Agency service fee lines standing on the booking | The agency service fee retained |
| --- | --- |
| One for each traveller, or more | The total of the service fee lines standing on the booking |
| At least one, but fewer than there are travellers | The agency service fee of the fare brand held, taken once for each traveller on the booking |
| None | The agency service fee of the fare brand held, taken once |

Each clause turns on the count of those lines against the count of travellers carried, and on nothing else; a booking carrying one traveller with one such line standing falls on the first clause, the line standing for each traveller carried.

**Worked determination on hypothetical figures.** Take a booking carrying three travellers. Where three agency service fee lines stand on it, hypothetically of 18.00 US dollars each, the agency service fee retained is 54.00 US dollars, being the total of the lines standing. Where only one such line stands on that booking, the agency service fee retained is the agency service fee of the fare brand held taken three times, once for each traveller carried. Where no such line stands at all, the agency service fee retained is that same fee taken once, however many travellers the booking carries.
